propositions: The Pass-1 ladder in plan-review.yaml uses bare Anthropic model ids, so a run configured for another provider still resolves to direct Anthropic, a split-brain in the pass doing most of the work.
Expressing ladder rungs as class names (trivial/standard/frontier) resolved at runtime via the existing resolve_model_string makes the ladder provider-portable without a schema change.
models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic ids for a Bedrock primary via substring match, causing silent cross-provider escalation that must be fixed by mapping at-or-above rungs through class config.
MODEL_LADDER must stay unchanged with bare names and windows, and largest_window_tokens must remain byte-for-byte identical, since class names would break its substring-based context-window lookup.
A third ladder consumer, DefaultBatchRunner.run in workflow/runners.py, has the identical model_ladder[0] split-brain and must also resolve class-named rungs.

config.py must import model_classes lazily inside the function body to avoid closing an import cycle, and class resolution must degrade to the bare name when nothing is configured to preserve back-compat.
